topics.title: Get started with DocuScan Pro
topics.sub: Overview of the four main workflows and the Home screen.
topics.purpose: Understand what DocuScan Pro does and where to begin.
topics.prerequisites: A web browser. No account required.

steps.title: Welcome
steps.body: DocuScan Pro is a browser-based tool for scanning documents, creating PDFs, signing them, and organizing files locally. Everything stays on your device.

steps.title: Home screen
steps.body: When you open the app you land on the Home screen. It shows four prominent workflow cards: Studio, Sign, PDF Tools, and Library.

steps.title: Quick start list
steps.body: Below the four cards, a Quick start list lets you jump directly into the most common tasks: scanning, signing, or opening a saved document.

steps.title: Bottom navigation
steps.body: The bar pinned to the bottom of every screen has six icons: Home, Sign, Tools, Studio, Library, and Help. Use it to switch workspaces at any time.

topics.troubleshooting: If you don't see the four cards, you may have scrolled — try scrolling up or pressing Home in the bottom navigation.

topics.title: Scan or import a document
topics.sub: Capture with your camera or import existing images, then build a PDF.
topics.purpose: Turn paper documents or existing images into clean PDF files.
topics.prerequisites: A camera-equipped device (for capture) or images on your device.

steps.title: Open Studio
steps.body: Tap Studio in the bottom navigation. Select an Expense claim, Signed document, or My checklist template if you want to track what belongs in the packet.

steps.title: Capture with camera
steps.body: Tap "Capture with camera". Your browser will request camera permission. On phones, the rear camera is preferred. Capture a page; tap to retake if needed.

steps.title: Or import images
steps.body: Tap Import files to choose photos and ordinary PDFs together. Select a thumbnail, then use Move page earlier or Move page later to move it one position in the exported packet. The preview arrows only browse. Fillable or password-protected PDFs open separately in PDF Tools.

steps.title: Review thumbnails
steps.body: Captured or imported pages appear in the Pages strip as numbered thumbnails. Tap a thumbnail to select it. Selected pages are outlined in blue.

steps.title: Rotate, reorder, delete
steps.body: Use Rotate, ‹ Move left, Move right ›, or Delete on the selected page. Clear all empties the strip.

steps.title: Enhance
steps.body: Pick a preset (Auto, Grayscale, B&W, Brighten, Contrast+), optionally adjust Brightness / Contrast sliders, then tap Apply to selected page. The original is preserved — Reset restores it.

steps.title: Run OCR (optional)
steps.body: Tap Scan to recognize all imported image pages. Watch the loading status while the OCR engine and language model prepare; recognition progress then shows the current page and overall completion. Recognized text appears in the textarea and can be copied or downloaded as .txt.

steps.title: Create the PDF
steps.body: Choose page size (Letter, A4, or Fit-to-image) and orientation (Auto, Portrait, Landscape), then tap Create PDF. The PDF is saved to your Library automatically.

steps.title: Hand off
steps.body: Use Edit in Sign › or Edit in Tools › to continue working on the new PDF without leaving the app.

topics.troubleshooting: If the camera doesn't open, check browser permissions (Settings → Privacy → Camera) and confirm you're on HTTPS. As a fallback, use Import files to pick a photo from your camera roll.

topics.title: Enhance image quality
topics.sub: Brighten, sharpen, convert to grayscale or black-and-white.
topics.purpose: Improve readability of scanned or photographed pages.
topics.prerequisites: At least one page loaded in Studio.

steps.title: Select a page
steps.body: Tap the thumbnail of the page you want to improve. A blue outline confirms the selection.

steps.title: Choose a preset
steps.body: Tap one of the chips in the Enhancement section: Original, Auto, Grayscale, B&W, Brighten, or Contrast+.

steps.title: Fine-tune (optional)
steps.body: Drag the Brightness and Contrast sliders. The numbers update live (-100 to +100).

steps.title: Apply
steps.body: Tap Apply to selected page. The thumbnail updates to reflect the changes.

steps.title: Reset
steps.body: Tap Reset to restore the original image. The original canvas is preserved, so this is always safe.

topics.troubleshooting: If the thumbnail doesn't change after Apply, make sure a page is selected (blue outline) before tapping Apply. If the colors look wrong, try Original to revert.

topics.title: Recognize text with OCR
topics.sub: Extract searchable, copyable text from scanned pages.
topics.purpose: Turn scanned images into editable, searchable text.
topics.prerequisites: A scanned page with printed text. Handwriting is not well supported.

steps.title: Select a page
steps.body: Tap a thumbnail in the Pages strip.

steps.title: Run OCR
steps.body: Tap Scan to recognize the image pages in Studio. Existing PDF pages keep their original content and searchable text.

steps.title: Watch the progress bar
steps.body: A progress bar appears below the Run OCR button. On the first run it may pause while the language model downloads (a few MB).

steps.title: Review recognized text
steps.body: When complete, the recognized text appears in the textarea. It may include minor errors — OCR is never perfect.

steps.title: Copy or download
steps.body: Tap PDF to save a searchable copy to Library. Download .txt exports a separate text file. Run Scan again after editing an image if you want its latest text embedded.

topics.troubleshooting: If OCR returns "(No text recognized.)", try a higher-resolution scan, sharper lighting, or convert the image to B&W first. The first run downloads OCR components and language data; loading time depends on the connection. Loading and recognizing are shown as separate stages. Later runs can reuse cached assets.

topics.title: Create a PDF from pages
topics.sub: Combine images into a single PDF with the page size you want.
topics.purpose: Assemble one or more images into a single PDF document.
topics.prerequisites: At least one page loaded in Studio.

steps.title: Choose page size
steps.body: In the Create PDF section, pick Letter (8.5×11"), A4 (210×297mm), or Fit to image.

steps.title: Choose orientation
steps.body: Pick Auto (uses each image's aspect ratio), Portrait, or Landscape.

steps.title: Create PDF
steps.body: Tap Create PDF. Enter a name in the dialog and choose Save to store the PDF in Library. Cancel or Escape closes the dialog without saving. Names are cleaned for portability and exported with one .pdf extension. Choose Small, Standard or Original quality for photo pages. OCR from unchanged image pages is embedded as searchable text.

steps.title: Hand off
steps.body: Optionally tap Edit in Sign › or Edit in Tools › to continue working.

topics.troubleshooting: If Create PDF is disabled, add at least one page first. If the button shows a spinner forever, the network may be slow loading pdf-lib — try again in a moment.

topics.title: Sign a PDF document
topics.sub: Open an existing PDF and add your signature, then download.
topics.purpose: Add your signature to an existing PDF.
topics.prerequisites: A PDF file on your device.

steps.title: Open the PDF
steps.body: Tap Open PDF from Files at the top of the left sidebar in the Sign workspace. Choose a PDF. It loads in the preview on the right.

steps.title: Create a signature
steps.body: Tap the Signature button (one of the six editing buttons in two rows of three). A sheet slides up with two tabs: Draw and Type.

steps.title: Draw or type
steps.body: In Draw mode, sign with your finger, Apple Pencil, or mouse on the signature pad. In Type mode, enter your name and pick a font style.

steps.title: Insert
steps.body: Tap Insert signature. The signature is placed at the center of the current page as a movable overlay.

steps.title: Move and resize
steps.body: Click the signature to select it (blue border + resize dot appears). Drag the body to move; drag the blue dot in the bottom-right corner to scale.

steps.title: Download
steps.body: When you're happy, tap Download PDF to save the signed PDF to your device. Use Library if you want to keep it in the app for later.

topics.troubleshooting: If the signature doesn't appear, check that you're on the correct page (use the page navigation bar). If the overlay shows the wrong color, set the Ink color before inserting.

topics.title: Add text to a PDF
topics.sub: Insert custom text or use Quick Text Templates.
topics.purpose: Add typed text or reusable phrases to a PDF.
topics.prerequisites: A PDF open in the Sign workspace.

steps.title: Type your text
steps.body: In the Text / typed signature field, type the text you want to insert. Or pick from Quick Text Templates (Approved, Received, Paid, Confidential, Draft, Final, For Review).

steps.title: Choose font
steps.body: Pick a Font style (Helvetica, Times Roman, Courier, etc.) and a Font size in points. This controls the text inside the PDF, not the interface.

steps.title: Pick ink color
steps.body: Use the Ink color color picker. The color you pick is the color of the text in the final PDF.

steps.title: Insert
steps.body: Tap Text, then tap the PDF where the text should appear. Repeated Text taps do not add extra annotations. You can also type text and tap directly on the preview.

steps.title: Move and resize
steps.body: Click the text element to select it. Drag the body to reposition; drag the blue dot in the bottom-right corner to scale.

topics.troubleshooting: If nothing happens when you click on the page, make sure the Text / typed signature field isn't empty — type something first. If the ink color doesn't match, set the color before inserting.

topics.title: Insert the current date
topics.sub: Add today's date to a PDF in one tap.
topics.purpose: Stamp the current date onto a PDF.
topics.prerequisites: A PDF open in the Sign workspace.

steps.title: Pick font and color
steps.body: Set the Font style, Font size, and Ink color as you want the date to appear.

steps.title: Tap Date
steps.body: Tap the Date button (one of the six editing buttons). Today's date is inserted near the bottom of the current page.

steps.title: Move if needed
steps.body: Click the date text to select it, then drag to move it to your preferred position.

topics.troubleshooting: The date is generated by your browser's locale. If the format isn't what you want, type your own date into the Text field instead and use the Text button.

topics.title: Add a watermark to a PDF
topics.sub: Stamp DRAFT, CONFIDENTIAL, or any text across all pages.
topics.purpose: Apply a text watermark to every page of a PDF.
topics.prerequisites: A PDF open in the Sign workspace.

steps.title: Configure the watermark
steps.body: In the Watermark section: set Watermark text (default DRAFT), pick Direction (Diagonal ↗ or Horizontal), and set Opacity (0-100%).

steps.title: Insert
steps.body: Tap Insert. The watermark is applied across ALL pages of the document. A badge confirms "Watermark applied".

steps.title: Verify
steps.body: The displayed opacity value matches the actual opacity baked into the PDF.

steps.title: Remove
steps.body: Tap Remove watermark to revert. (Note: this currently reverts to the originally-loaded PDF and discards other edits added after the watermark.)

topics.troubleshooting: If the watermark is invisible, increase the Opacity. At 0% it's fully transparent. At 100% it's solid gray text.

topics.title: Undo, Redo, and Remove Selected
topics.sub: Correct mistakes and remove individual elements.
topics.purpose: Revert changes and clean up unwanted elements.
topics.prerequisites: A PDF open in the Sign workspace.

steps.title: Undo
steps.body: Tap Undo (one of the six editing buttons, bottom row). Each press reverts to the previous state in the history stack.

steps.title: Redo
steps.body: Tap Redo to re-apply a change you just undid. The Redo stack clears when you make a new edit.

steps.title: Remove Selected
steps.body: Tap an element on the canvas to select it (blue border + resize dot). Then tap Remove Selected to delete it.

topics.troubleshooting: If Undo is disabled, you're at the bottom of the history stack. If Remove Selected is disabled, no element is currently selected — click on one first.

topics.title: Save, download, share, and print
topics.sub: Four export actions available across Studio, Sign, and PDF Tools.
topics.purpose: Understand the four consistent export actions and when to use each.
topics.prerequisites: A document ready to export.

steps.title: Library
steps.body: Stores the document in the app's local IndexedDB library. Use this when you want to come back to the document later from inside DocuScan Pro.

steps.title: Download PDF
steps.body: Triggers a browser download of the PDF file to your device. The file lands in your normal Downloads folder.

steps.title: Share PDF
steps.body: Shows the PDF file size first. If a smaller copy is available, choose it or share the selected quality. Supporting devices open the system share sheet. Other browsers download the selected copy.

steps.title: Print PDF
steps.body: Opens the browser's print dialog in a hidden iframe so you don't lose your place in the app. Choose your printer and paper as usual.

topics.troubleshooting: If Share doesn't show the system sheet, your browser doesn't support Web Share API for files — use Download instead. Print may pop a blocker; allow pop-ups for the app.

topics.title: Merge two or more PDFs
topics.sub: Combine multiple PDFs into one document.
topics.purpose: Combine several PDFs into a single file.
topics.prerequisites: Two or more PDF files on your device.

steps.title: Open the primary PDF
steps.body: In PDF Tools, tap Open PDF. This is File A — the base document.

steps.title: Open a second PDF
steps.body: Tap Open 2nd PDF (for merge). This is File B.

steps.title: Select Merge
steps.body: Tap the Merge tab in the Operation row.

steps.title: Choose order
steps.body: Pick Append second PDF (B comes after A) or Prepend second PDF (B comes before A).

steps.title: Run
steps.body: Tap Run. The merged PDF appears in the Preview area.

steps.title: Export
steps.body: Use Library, Download, Share, or Print at the bottom of the card.

topics.troubleshooting: If Run is disabled, you haven't loaded both PDFs yet. Open PDF = File A, Open 2nd PDF = File B.

topics.title: Split a PDF by page ranges
topics.sub: Divide a multipage PDF into separate files.
topics.purpose: Extract specific pages or ranges from a PDF.
topics.prerequisites: A PDF with multiple pages.

steps.title: Open the PDF
steps.body: Tap Open PDF in PDF Tools.

steps.title: Select Split
steps.body: Tap the Split tab.

steps.title: Enter ranges
steps.body: Type page ranges in the format 1-3,5,8-10. Spaces around the dashes are optional. The total page count is shown for reference.

steps.title: Run
steps.body: Tap Run. The first split file appears in the Preview area; additional files are saved to your Library automatically with names like "Split part 2".

steps.title: Export
steps.body: Use Save / Download / Share / Print for the first file. Additional parts are already in your Library.

topics.troubleshooting: If you see "Range X-Y out of bounds", check the total page count shown in the panel. Ranges are 1-indexed and must satisfy 1 ≤ from ≤ to ≤ total.

topics.title: Rotate PDF pages
topics.sub: Rotate every page by 90°, 180°, or 270°.
topics.purpose: Fix pages that are sideways or upside down.
topics.prerequisites: A PDF open in PDF Tools.

steps.title: Open the PDF
steps.body: Tap Open PDF in PDF Tools.

steps.title: Select Rotate
steps.body: Tap the Rotate tab.

steps.title: Pick angle
steps.body: Tap 90°, 180°, or 270°. Rotation is applied cumulatively on top of the existing orientation.

steps.title: Run + Export
steps.body: Tap Run to apply, then use Save / Download / Share / Print.

topics.troubleshooting: Rotation applies to ALL pages in the document. If you need to rotate only specific pages, split first, rotate the part, then merge.

topics.title: Reorder PDF pages
topics.sub: Rearrange pages into a new sequence.
topics.purpose: Change the page order of a multipage PDF.
topics.prerequisites: A multipage PDF open in PDF Tools.

steps.title: Open the PDF
steps.body: Tap Open PDF in PDF Tools.

steps.title: Select Reorder
steps.body: Tap the Reorder tab.

steps.title: Enter new order
steps.body: Type a comma-separated list of the new page positions, 1-indexed. For a 3-page PDF, "3,1,2" moves page 3 to position 1, page 1 to position 2, and page 2 to position 3. The placeholder shows the default order.

steps.title: Run + Export
steps.body: Tap Run, then Save / Download / Share / Print.

topics.troubleshooting: The list must be a complete permutation. For 3 pages you need exactly 3 unique numbers from 1-3. Duplicates or missing numbers will be rejected.

topics.title: Annotate a PDF with text
topics.sub: Add typed annotations like "Reviewed by J.S." to a chosen page.
topics.purpose: Add text annotations to PDF pages.
topics.prerequisites: A PDF open in PDF Tools.

steps.title: Open the PDF
steps.body: Tap Open PDF in PDF Tools.

steps.title: Select Annotate
steps.body: Tap the Annotate tab. Two sub-tabs appear: Text and Draw.

steps.title: Stay in Text mode
steps.body: The Text sub-tab is active by default.

steps.title: Set page + text
steps.body: Pick the Page number and type the annotation Text (e.g. "Reviewed by J.S.").

steps.title: Position + color
steps.body: Set Position X and Position Y as percentages (0-100), pick an Ink color, and a Font size in points.

steps.title: Run + Export
steps.body: Tap Run to bake the annotation into the PDF, then Save / Download / Share / Print.

topics.troubleshooting: If Run is disabled, type some text first. The annotation appears at the chosen X/Y position (0,0 = top-left; 100,100 = bottom-right).

topics.title: Draw freehand on a PDF
topics.sub: Circle, underline, or mark up a PDF with your finger, Apple Pencil, or mouse.
topics.purpose: Add freehand drawings (circles, arrows, underlines) directly onto PDF pages.
topics.prerequisites: A PDF open in PDF Tools, ideally with Preview loaded.

steps.title: Open the PDF
steps.body: Tap Open PDF in PDF Tools. Wait for the page to render in the Preview area.

steps.title: Select Annotate → Draw
steps.body: Tap the Annotate tab, then the Draw sub-tab.

steps.title: Choose pen settings
steps.body: Pick the Page to draw on, choose a Pen color, and adjust Pen width (1-20).

steps.title: Draw
steps.body: Draw directly on the page preview with your finger, Apple Pencil, or mouse. Strokes appear in real time on the transparent overlay.

steps.title: Clear (optional)
steps.body: Tap Clear strokes to start over without affecting the underlying PDF.

steps.title: Run + Export
steps.body: Tap Run to bake the strokes into the PDF as a transparent PNG layer. Then use Save / Download / Share / Print.

topics.troubleshooting: If the draw canvas doesn't respond, make sure you're in the Draw sub-tab (not Text). The overlay sits exactly on top of the rendered page — strokes map 1:1 to PDF coordinates.

topics.title: Apply a watermark in PDF Tools
topics.sub: Apply text or a logo across a PDF.
topics.purpose: Apply a text or image watermark across all pages of a PDF.
topics.prerequisites: A PDF open in PDF Tools.

steps.title: Open the PDF
steps.body: Tap Open PDF in PDF Tools.

steps.title: Select Watermark
steps.body: Under Markup, tap Watermark and choose Text or Image.

steps.title: Configure
steps.body: For Text, set the wording, direction and opacity. For Image, upload a logo and set size, opacity, and the X and Y position.

steps.title: Run + Export
steps.body: Tap Run, then Save / Download / Share / Print.

topics.troubleshooting: If the watermark is invisible, increase opacity and review its position.

topics.title: Compare two PDFs side-by-side
topics.sub: View File A and File B at the same scale for visual comparison.
topics.purpose: Visually compare two PDFs without leaving the app.
topics.prerequisites: Two PDF files on your device.

steps.title: Open File A
steps.body: Tap Open PDF in PDF Tools. This is File A.

steps.title: Open File B
steps.body: Tap Open 2nd PDF (for merge). This is File B.

steps.title: Select Compare
steps.body: Tap the Compare tab. The Preview area below shows two labeled panes.

steps.title: Run
steps.body: Tap Run. Both first pages render at 380px width in their labeled panes.

steps.title: Compare
steps.body: Scroll the page to see both side-by-side. On mobile (below 768px), the panes stack vertically.

topics.troubleshooting: Compare is view-only — it doesn't modify either PDF. To produce a merged file, use the Merge tab instead.

topics.title: Use the document Library
topics.sub: Local storage, open / rename / delete saved documents.
topics.purpose: Manage documents saved locally in your browser.
topics.prerequisites: None. The Library is always available.

steps.title: Open Library
steps.body: Tap Library in the bottom navigation. Saved documents appear in compact rows. Choose a file action above the list, then select the files.

steps.title: Open in Sign
steps.body: Choose Open in Sign or Open in Tools, select one PDF, then confirm.

steps.title: Move files
steps.body: Choose Move, select one or more files, then choose a folder.

steps.title: Rename
steps.body: Choose Rename and select one or more files. Enter a separate name for each file in the naming dialog. Choose Save, or Cancel to stop renaming.

steps.title: Delete
steps.body: Choose Delete and select the files. Confirm the count before deleting.

steps.title: Share
steps.body: Choose Share and select one PDF. Review the file size and choose how to share it.

steps.title: Refresh
steps.body: Tap Refresh to re-query IndexedDB if you've saved from another workspace.

topics.troubleshooting: Browser-local storage is NOT cloud backup. If you clear site data, reset the browser, or remove storage, saved documents are lost. To be safe, use Download on important documents.

topics.title: Use the Help system
topics.sub: Find topics, search, and restart the interactive tutorial.
topics.purpose: Navigate the Help Center and restart walkthroughs.
topics.prerequisites: None.

steps.title: Open Help
steps.body: Tap Help in the bottom navigation.

steps.title: Search
steps.body: Use the search field at the top. Type "sign", "scan", "watermark", "merge", etc. Topics filter live as you type.

steps.title: Open a topic
steps.body: Tap any topic card to open the full illustrated article. Articles include Purpose, Prerequisites, numbered Steps, Troubleshooting, and Related topics.

steps.title: Back
steps.body: Tap ‹ Back at the top of any article to return to the topic grid.

steps.title: Restart tutorial
steps.body: At the bottom of the Help workspace is a "Restart interactive tutorial" button. Tap it to replay the Home walkthrough from the beginning.

topics.troubleshooting: If search returns no results, try shorter keywords. The search matches against titles, subtitles, and tags.

topics.title: Troubleshooting common issues
topics.sub: Camera, OCR, sharing, offline, and lost documents.
topics.purpose: Solve common problems quickly.
topics.prerequisites: None.

steps.title: Camera doesn't open
steps.body: Check browser permissions (Settings → Privacy → Camera). Confirm the site is on HTTPS. As a fallback, use Import files.

steps.title: OCR is slow
steps.body: The first run downloads the Tesseract language model (a few MB). Subsequent runs are faster and work offline once cached.

steps.title: PDF won't open
steps.body: Make sure it's not password-protected. DocuScan Pro can parse encrypted PDFs but cannot re-save them.

steps.title: Sharing unavailable
steps.body: Some browsers don't support the Web Share API for files. The app automatically falls back to a download.

steps.title: Lost documents
steps.body: Browser-local storage is not cloud backup. Clearing site data, resetting the browser, or removing storage deletes saved documents. Always Download important files.

steps.title: Offline use
steps.body: The app shell and all dependencies are cached by the service worker. OCR, PDF preview, and PDF editing all work offline once the assets are cached.

topics.troubleshooting: For anything else, restart your browser. If problems persist, the app may have been updated — refresh to grab the latest version.

topics.title: Privacy and local storage
topics.sub: What stays on your device, what doesn't, and how to back up.
topics.purpose: Understand exactly what happens to your documents.
topics.prerequisites: None.

steps.title: Local-first
steps.body: Documents are processed in your browser and stored in IndexedDB on your device.

steps.title: No uploads
steps.body: Nothing in the application transmits document content to any server.

steps.title: OCR on-device
steps.body: Tesseract.js runs entirely on-device once the language model is cached. First run downloads it from the official Tesseract data CDN.

steps.title: File validation
steps.body: Images are type- and size-validated before processing. PDFs are validated by checking the %PDF- magic bytes before parsing.

steps.title: No cloud backup
steps.body: Clearing site data, resetting the browser, or removing storage deletes saved documents. Use Download to save copies.

topics.troubleshooting: To check storage usage, open your browser's DevTools → Application → Storage. To clear all app data, use Clear site data — but back up first.

topics.title: Library · Library backup and restore
topics.sub: Export a backup, then move it to iCloud Drive or Google Drive using Files. On the other device choose Restore Library Backup and select the file. Each restore adds copies of the PDFs and folders.
topics.purpose: Export a backup, then move it to iCloud Drive or Google Drive using Files. On the other device choose Restore Library Backup and select the file. Each restore adds copies of the PDFs and folders.
topics.prerequisites: Open the workspace and load the required files.

steps.title: Library backup and restore
steps.body: Export a backup, then move it to iCloud Drive or Google Drive using Files. On the other device choose Restore Library Backup and select the file. Each restore adds copies of the PDFs and folders.

topics.title: PDF Tools · Talk to PDF
topics.sub: Open a searchable PDF, choose Talk to PDF, and ask a question. Review the matching passages and page numbers. For a scan, run Scan in Studio and create a searchable PDF first.

topics.sub: Choose Text for words or Image for a logo. Set opacity and apply it to all pages.
topics.purpose: Choose Text for words or Image for a logo. Set opacity and apply it to all pages.

steps.body: Choose Text for words or Image for a logo. Set opacity and apply it to all pages.

topics.purpose: Choose Image, upload a logo, then set Size and Opacity. Use Position X and Y to place it.

topics.sub: Enter header or footer text and choose a page number format, then apply.
topics.purpose: Enter header or footer text and choose a page number format, then apply.

topics.title: PDF Tools · Forms
